HFB 05 values identical whether read from the country response or its own
reasons: Root cause: the two levels are served from snapshots 28.4h apart — country-child generatedAt 2026-08-25T13:06:24Z vs direct HFB 2026-08-26T17:28:02Z. Reproduced identically on 3 consecutive runs, so not a race. All 27 other fields, including every index shown in the UI, agree.
Scope: HFBs 01-03 sampled by the API suite showed 0 differing fields, so the skew is per-HFB cache age rather than systemic.
results.note: compared 29 fields; only the two demand-plan YTD fields differ (0.0013% and 0.0005%)
